title: 经济学家：中国AI三大优势，如何重塑全球要素格局？
speaker: Unknown

segments.en: I think China has maybe three unique advantages in this AI revolution.
segments.zh: 我认为中国在这场AI变革中或许有三个独特优势。

segments.en: Number one is that you say it's adoption and real world scenarios and very broad users.
segments.zh: 第一是应用落地、真实场景和非常广泛的用户基础。

segments.en: Number two is maybe, you know, it's very cost-efficient, the open source model, open weight model.
segments.zh: 第二可能是成本效率很高，开源模型、开放权重模型。

segments.en: Number three is infrastructure and then the energy capacity.
segments.zh: 第三是基础设施和能源容量。

segments.en: So traditionally, if you have a big technology revolution, it changes many things, it changes the way you look at resources.
segments.zh: 传统上，如果发生重大技术变革，它会改变许多东西，改变你看待资源的方式。

segments.en: For example, you know, the first industrial revolution make co- very important. Second, make it extremely, very important.
segments.zh: 例如，第一次工业革命让煤炭变得非常重要。第二次则让它极其重要。

segments.en: I think that's just the current one we make, you know, not only chips important, but also electricity important again.
segments.zh: 我认为当前这一轮，不仅芯片重要，电力也再次变得重要。

segments.en: You know, also, I think the change is, that's what we talk about about inputs, inputs are shifted.
segments.zh: 另外，我认为变化在于我们所说的投入要素发生了转移。

segments.en: And I also think it will change relationship between financial markets and the real world investment.
segments.zh: 我还认为，它将改变金融市场与实体投入之间的关系。

segments.en: You know, AI is kind of Bob Bayer. On the one hand, it's a lot of human capital in terms of building a model. On the other hand, it's also very capital intensive.
segments.zh: AI有点像双面手。一方面，构建模型需要大量人力资本。另一方面，它也非常资本密集。

segments.en: You need a big data center, in a cooling center, energy.
segments.zh: 你需要大型数据中心、冷却中心和能源。

segments.en: So that means both, you know, equity market or risk investment, and fixing come market can also play.
segments.zh: 这意味着权益市场或风险投入，以及固定收益市场都能发挥作用。

segments.en: So that's, I think, the second part, you know, it changes the relationship between financial market and the real world investment.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是第二部分，它改变了金融市场与实体投入之间的关系。
